title: Seat
description: Seat (Seat): a commission chair of a tenant or the farm manager seat. Only the charter declares seats (GOV-33). Only the core writes the holder, in one transaction that increases the seat epoch by 1 and writes a seat event and an audit record (IDN-10). The farm manager seat is a record of the service tenant farm: holder, epoch, state and the set of stop reasons with the time of each; only numbers and codes (MGR-1, MGR-3, GOV-16). The seat is in held only when the set of reasons is empty.

id.description: Seat id: farm-manager (the farm manager seat, tenant farm) or commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>.

tenant.description: Seat tenant; farm for the farm manager seat.

holder.description: Holder: a bot identity with the binding mode: seat, or null.

epoch.description: Seat epoch; grows on assignment and vacating, on each new stop reason and on return to held.

state.description: State of the seat lifecycle (spec/lifecycles/seat.md); stopped happens only for the farm manager seat.

stop_reasons.description: Set of stop reasons with the time of each; reasons are added without releasing each other.

reason.description: Stop reason of the farm manager seat: human (stop on the seat scope, MGR-15), no_control (safeguard, MGR-14), incident (a stopping incident, GOV-22).

paused_in.description: Seat pauses per tenant by the money safeguard of the manager line (MGR-14): seat tasks in the tenant are not handed out until until, the epoch does not change, and the seat stays held.

until.description: Start of the next daily window of the line.

decide_until.description: With the reason incident: the end of the incident_stop.decide_within period (default and at most 7 days), after which the identity lifecycle retires the holder with the trigger replaced_after_incident.
